description: Longitudinal bipolar montage sensitivity analysis (06 v1.1 issue 11, §5); run plan C approved by Josue 2026-10-17. Pre-specified; descriptive (06 §4.4); never assigns or revises the RESULT-001 label.

factors_changed.montage: double banana, 18 derivations (Fp1-F7, F7-T3, T3-T5, T5-O1, Fp2-F8, F8-T4, T4-T6, T6-O2, Fp1-F3, F3-C3, C3-P3, P3-O1, Fp2-F4, F4-C4, C4-P4, P4-O2, Fz-Cz, Cz-Pz) from the 19 stored rows, no further re-referencing (src/preprocessing/montage.py)
factors_changed.per_channel_representations: B0/B1 (18 x 24), per-derivation peak salience for the B2 count (robust z per derivation, recording-wide), topography and ADJ graph on derivation midpoints (06 issue 11), FC and FC_surr on 153 edges per band (459)

unchanged_from_exp004.window: label-blind salience-selected 2-s window chosen on the CAR salience exactly as in EXP-004 (06 issue 1), so the montage is the only factor that changes
unchanged_from_exp004.epochs_and_exclusions: 06 §4.2 locked exclusions (same kept epochs as EXP-004); the cache check must reproduce the F-6 recount
unchanged_from_exp004.evaluability: >= 5 IED and >= 5 non-IED epochs in a common state (artifacts/dataset_audit/evaluable_recount.csv)
unchanged_from_exp004.fc: wPLI theta/alpha/beta, §4.3 steps 2-8 (filter on the continuous derivation, Hilbert, window, wPLI); IAAFT k = 5 per band (D1, 2-s window)

z_star.note: reused unchanged (same default as EXP-010); applied to per-derivation peak salience

unchanged_from_exp004.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, locked grid (16 points), max_iter 300, no early stopping; random_state = repeat seed + outer fold
unchanged_from_exp004.tuning: nested inner CV, mean within-patient same-state AUROC; ties -> simpler
unchanged_from_exp004.estimand: procedure-level within-patient same-state DeltaAUROC, equal patient weight, per-repeat Delta averaged over repeats

learner_note: primary learner only; the LR learner is its own robustness factor (06 §5) and is not crossed with the montage

inference.interval: M1 (06 v1.1 §4.4; RDR-014), 90% and 95%; patient-cluster percentile bootstrap 90%/95% alongside
inference.heterogeneity: R6: SD of Delta_p, 95% prediction interval, range, counts beyond +/- SESOI
inference.state_strata: estimate + 95% percentile bootstrap CI, no outcome label (R10)
inference.pc1: FC-only on the bipolar montage, M1 95% lower bound of mean AUROC; reported, not a gate here

reading.rule: the seven-rule taxonomy (src/evaluation/taxonomy.classify) applied to the M1 intervals is reported as a descriptive reading of this sensitivity analysis only, never as a label for H-1

concordance.inconclusive: inconclusive (too imprecise to agree or disagree)
